description: This file provides utility functions for tokenizing and serializing message blocks for the Anthropic API, including handling text, images, and tool-related message blocks, with token counting and serialization logic.

methods.name: serializeToolUse
methods.description: Serializes a tool_use block to text for token counting, approximating API call representation.

methods.name: serializeToolResult
methods.description: Serializes a tool_result block to text for token counting, handling string and array content.

methods.name: tiktoken
methods.description: Calculates the number of tokens in a list of content blocks, handling text, images, and tool message blocks, with a fudge factor for accuracy.
